environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TLS termination. The service is directly exposed on port 8080 via target group. No application-layer proxy or filtering is configured. IAM role attached to the instance has AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy for management. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 forwarded to 8080.
